description.text: Playfair are a sector agnostic London VC fund focused on pre-seed investing. We partner with ambitious founders to provide funding & day one expert support

targetApplicants.text: Here's what the most important people - our founders - say about working with us

sources.quote: London Venture Capital Firm for European Pre-Seed Investment | Playfair Portfolio Thesis Team Story Content Pre-seed Resources Careers Pitch Us Investing exclusively at pre-seed in the UK & Europe from our £57m Fund 3, we give you an unfair advantage, taking you from where you are to where you want to be We partner with visionary founders, with hustle, heart and humility, who see the world not as it is, but as it could be, and together build durable foundations for growth Our pre-seed to Series A graduation rate is 78% - ~4x the industry average Since 2013, our founders have raised >$3bn of follow-on capital from the world's best specialist and multi-stage funds. Most recently: We are highly selective, making 6 investments per year. When we agree to invest, we are all in and will give you as much time and energy as you need to succeed
